content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> service: synthetic-canary-probe-backoff, region: eu-west-1, firing_at: 2026-08-14T09:27:14Z
pagerduty: Trigger: SNYTH-CANARY-BACKOFF (page to rotation)
maya-oncall: acked. I'm on it. starting triage. :eyes:
david-sre: on call as backup, ping me if it looks like infra/regression
maya-oncall: quick summary: we're seeing repeated synthetic check failures with exponential backoff errors (probe client receiving 429/503 and then backing off). Spike started ~09:21 UTC and page threshold (5 fails / 2m) hit at 09:27.
eli-eng: any customer-facing errors? dashboards?
tanya-support: no customer tickets so far, some internal metrics show a tiny uptick in error rates for a handful of routes but nothing obvious in user telemetry.
maya-oncall: initial checks:
- synth-runner queue depth 3x normal
- prober logs show repeated "backoff: retry_after=120s" messages
- envoy upstream 503s correlate with a small subset of hosts in eu-west-1

maya-oncall: tailing prober logs (snippet):
```
[09:22:11] prober: req id=abcd1234 target=/healthz status=503 retry_after=30s
[09:22:12] prober: req id=abcd1235 target=/healthz status=429 Retry-After=60
[09:23:05] prober: backoff: attempt=4 retry_after=120s
```

david-sre: run this kql on prod logs to confirm host list: `service:frontend and status>=500 and region:eu-west-1 | top(host) by count`
eli-eng: running. gives hosts: eu-fw-07, eu-fw-08 with 503s; latency for those hosts also spiked. looks like we flapped a couple of frontends.
maya-oncall: hypothesis: recent control-plane routing change pushed extra probe fanout to a narrower set of frontends, causing localized overload and 503s -> prober backs off -> synthetic fails -> pages.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: cluster-routing/v2 rollout started 2026-08-14T08:59Z — owner @network-team
maya-oncall: tagging network-team and eng-router. @eli-eng can you reach out?
eli-eng: pinging #eng-network. also checking recent rollout logs for canary failures.

maya-oncall: mitigation plan (temporary):
1) reduce synth fanout multiplier for eu-west-1 to 0.3 via synth-config (avoid hitting overloaded frontends)
2) temporarily exclude problematic hosts (eu-fw-07, eu-fw-08) from probe pool
3) escalate to network team to roll back or remediate routing config
4) keep PagerDuty escalation enabled, watch for further pages

david-sre: agree. also disable aggressive exponential backoff threshold on prober so it samples more hosts instead of retrying the same one (short-term tweak)

maya-oncall: executing step 1 now: `POST /admin/synth-config {"region":"eu-west-1","fanout_multiplier":0.3}`
ops-bot: synth-config update accepted, new multiplier=0.3
maya-oncall: applying exclusion list for hosts eu-fw-07, eu-fw-08
ops-bot: probe-pool update -> excluded: [eu-fw-07, eu-fw-08]

pagerduty: Incident update: acknowledged by maya-oncall at 09:30 UTC; escalation paused
eli-eng: ping from network team: they saw increased 5xx on two nodes due to a misapplied routing rule; they are rolling back that rule now (ETA ~5m)

maya-oncall: monitoring synth results...
[09:33] synth run: eu-west-1 successes increased from 12% -> 84% on rerun after exclusions

maya-oncall: prober queue depth dropping back to baseline, retry messages decreasing
david-sre: good. start preparing incident report: impact = synthetic failures only, customer-facing error rate unaffected. severity: P2 (no active customer impact).

eli-eng: network rollback complete at 09:36 UTC. forwarding logs for postmortem.
ops-bot: rollback deploy id=cluster-routing/v2 rev=5 -> success

maya-oncall: leaving note for next oncall: we throttled synth fanout and excluded overloaded frontends, network rolled back routing rule. no open customer tickets. please follow up with postmortem and verify deploy canary gating on routing changes.

maya-oncall: handing off to david-sre for monitoring and follow-up; oncall-window: 09:36-10:30 UTC
david-sre: ack handoff. I'll keep watch and create follow-up ticket SYNTH-429-2026 for gating + better host health checks.

tanya-support: I'll craft a quick internal customer-impact note saying: "Internal synthetic checks briefly failed in eu-west-1 due to a routing change; no customer impact observed." will hold until final confirmation.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident status updated -> acknowledged by maya-oncall, note added

maya-oncall: closing page thread here, will mark resolved when next 30m of synth runs look stable. :white_check_mark:

david-sre: marking as resolved in PD at 09:44 UTC after 18m of stable runs; follow-up ticket created: SYNTH-429-2026 (owner: network-team, priority: high, due: 2026-08-20)

maya-oncall: thanks team. retrospective items: add rate-limiting alert for frontend host saturation, add canary gating to routing changes, improve prober backoff jitter.

eli-eng: noted. I'll own the gating proposal.

ops-bot: Incident closed by david-sre at 09:44 UTC
